summary: This note is a short biography of Aziz Abdullah Ahmed Mirza, an Iraqi Kurdish judge born in Sulaymaniyah in 1927 who died on 5 August 2008. It covers his legal education at Baghdad University and his service on the High Court of Cassation in Erbil from 1996 to 2004. It also notes that he was the father of Professor Parosh Abdulla of Uppsala University in Sweden.
one_line: Biography of Aziz Abdullah Ahmed Mirza, an Iraqi Kurdish judge who served on the High Court of Cassation in Erbil.
key_facts: Aziz Abdullah Ahmed Mirza was an Iraqi Kurdish judge.
Aziz Abdullah Ahmed Mirza was born in 1927 in Sulaymaniyah, Kurdistan Region, Iraq.
Aziz Abdullah Ahmed Mirza died on 5 August 2008.
Aziz Abdullah Ahmed Mirza graduated from the Faculty of Law at Baghdad University in 1950.
Aziz Abdullah Ahmed Mirza was a member of the High Court of Cassation from 1996 till 2004.
The High Court of Cassation where Aziz Abdullah Ahmed Mirza served was located in Erbil, the capital of Kurdistan.
Aziz Abdullah Ahmed Mirza was the father of Professor Parosh Abdulla of Uppsala University in Sweden.
